name: Expanding Horizons
objectiveText: Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind. Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there. Thundris' Letter (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: I guess this one is new to Forever? Don't remember it from original Wow.

This new quest teaches you how to reach Stormwind from Auberdine using the [b]new boat connection[/b].

The experience rewards for this chain are absolutely minuscule, but it's very much worth completing for the [item=282286] you'll receive after returning from the big city. This is the [b]best reagent bag you can obtain through questing[/b] [i](as of writing this)[/i]. You'll most likely be holding on to this until your [b]30s-40s[/b] [i]unless[/i] you go out of your way to buy a [item=253667] or [item=253973] (however, these are somewhat expensive investments due to the crafts requiring the use of [item=249409]).

For this quest, I recommend setting your [b]Hearthstone[/b] to [b]Auberdine[/b], then taking the boat to [b]Stormwind[/b] to complete the following objectives there:
[ol][li][quest=95065] (buy materials from [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=6301/gorbold-steelhand#map]Auberdine[/url])[/li]
[li][quest=97234] and the follow-up [quest=97237][/li]
[li][quest=97220] and the follow-up [quest=97222][/li]
[li][quest=7791] (if you have the capital...)[/li]
[li]Pay a visit to [npc=11867] for weapon training[/li][/ol]

You may also complete these if you wish, but know that they all only grant [b]10 XP[/b] at your level:
[ol][li][quest=332][/li]
[li][quest=333][/li]
[li][quest=334][/li][/ol]

Upon finishing up in Stormwind, simply [b]hearth back to Auberdine[/b] to turn this one in.
